summary: Data Engineer with 5+ years architecting enterprise data platforms, ELT/ETL pipelines, and analytical frameworks across Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and Apache Airflow. Expert in PySpark distributed processing, medallion (staging/marts) architectures, and Kimball dimensional design on AWS and Azure. Track record of processing multi-terabyte daily telemetry, unifying 50+ sources, cutting latency 30%+, and deploying reusable frameworks that shrink delivery timelines from weeks to days. Deep Structured Streaming and Kafka expertise, with domain depth in cybersecurity (SIEM, Splunk, Cribl), healthcare (FHIR/HIPAA), and GenAI/LLM systems.

Warehousing & ELT: Data Modeling (Kimball, Star & Snowflake Schema, Fact/Dimension)
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3, Lambda, Glue, SQS, Redshift, Step Functions, Secrets Manager, KMS, IAM)
Azure (Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL/SQL Server, Synapse, Key Vault, Entra ID)

highlights: Provided supervisor with one reliable source of truth by building and maintaining ETL pipelines to a single reporting database.
Delivered Power BI dashboards that turn raw package center metrics into at-a-glance operational views, day-to-day decisions for the team.
Reduced report generation time by optimizing SQL queries and data models, giving stakeholders faster access to the metrics they act on.
Reduced manual data-verification effort with automated Python validation scripts that catch integrity and consistency issues.

Engineered enterprise security pipelines in Snowflake and Databricks, processing multi-terabyte daily telemetry into a centralized warehouse powering global network anomaly detection and event correlation.
Reduced data processing latency 30%+ by orchestrating automated ELT workflows with Apache Airflow and Databricks Workflows on Terraform-provisioned, auto-scaling compute.
Unified logs from 50+ security tools into a single analytics layer, automating ingestion with Cribl, Airflow, and AWS Lambda (JSON → S3) and ending fragmented, tool-by-tool data access for analysts.
Cut new data-source onboarding effort 40% by building reusable ingestion templates and Airflow DAG generators the whole team adopted, delivering new analytics feeds in days instead of weeks.

Sped threat investigations for downstream analysts by engineering a layered staging→intermediate→marts (medallion) architecture of SQL-first transformations delivering clean, tested, analytics-ready security data.
Designed a log-routing architecture with Cribl ingesting high-volume telemetry from Splunk, plus custom REST API integrations pulling endpoint telemetry directly from CrowdStrike.
Enabled threat-hunting teams to spot suspicious activity within minutes through Structured Streaming and Kafka pipelines for logs.
Ensured data integrity across 10+ ELT pipelines running up to 5 concurrent executions with zero dependency failures through automated orchestration and dependency management.
Cut warehouse and storage costs $5,000/year through automated table-maintenance jobs, partition pruning, and clustering/compaction strategies for query-performance tuning.

Achieved consistent, reproducible releases with zero manual intervention by implementing Terraform modules for CI/CD for deploying jobs, warehouses/clusters, and permissions across dev, staging, and production.
Accelerated ELT development cycles 30% by integrating AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude Code) into development, validation, and documentation.

Reduced new data-source integration time 50% organization-wide by building a reusable Python REST API ingestion notebook (retry logic, pagination) that other teams adopted for external data onboarding.

Enabled self-service analytics and executive dashboards by designing dimensional star and snowflake schema data models (facts/dimensions) in the cloud data warehouse for reliable, decision-ready reporting.
Cut daily batch runtime by 30+ minutes and improved performance 15% by converting legacy SQL/T-SQL stored procedures into modular, version-controlled transformation frameworks in PySpark.
Increased pipeline scalability and maintainability with a metadata-driven ingestion framework in ADF automating source-to-target mapping, schema validation, and dynamic orchestration.
Improved data consistency and refresh accuracy 40%+ by engineering large-scale ELT in Azure Databricks and ADF that ingests and aggregates multi-source data into ADLS Gen2.
Accelerated transformations across billions of records by tuning partitioning, caching, and shuffle strategies for high-performance jobs.
Reduced maintenance windows 30 min/run via automated table lifecycle management using Python multiprocessing to parallelize vacuum and optimize operations.
Hardened business-critical feeds with rigorous data quality and validation checks (including automated schema-drift detection in Python) across all ingestion layers.
Improved report accuracy and cut data-request turnaround by authoring and optimizing complex SQL for BI reports used by product and marketing teams.
Reduced manual effort in recurring workflows with Python scripts for data cleaning, preprocessing, and file automation.
Supported automation of key business metrics and dashboards by building and maintaining SQL-driven pipelines for internal reporting platforms.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate data requirements into structured extraction and transformation processes.

projects.title: Security Log Analytics and Threat Detection Platform (Azure)
highlights: Built an end-to-end security-telemetry analytics platform on ADF and Databricks, processing firewall, endpoint, and network logs from ADLS Gen2 into SIEM-ready curated datasets via a layered staging→marts (medallion) architecture.
Automated infrastructure and scheduling with Terraform, Azure DevOps, and Apache Airflow for version-controlled, SLA-compliant, fully auditable production runs.

Developed PySpark and SQL transformations to clean, enrich, and structure raw JSON security events into Parquet/Delta datasets, with schema validation and data-quality checks that flag failed loads pre-consumption.
Delivered Power BI and Synapse dashboards surfacing real-time threat anomalies, top attack sources, and detection metrics for cybersecurity teams.

projects.title: Hybrid Healthcare Data Engineering Pipeline (FHIR → Warehouse Star Schema → RBAC)
highlights: Engineered a layered staging→intermediate→marts (Bronze→Silver→Gold) pipeline ingesting synthetic FHIR R4 bundles with PySpark, using dynamic resource fan-out to auto-discover and build dedicated staging tables for all 19 FHIR resource types, including Claims, Patients, Encounters, and Conditions.

Modeled a Kimball-compliant star schema (2 fact, 9 dimension tables) in the warehouse serving layer using deterministic MD5 surrogate keys to maintain referential integrity across complex FHIR reference patterns spanning Claim, Condition, and Procedure resources.
Combined batch and real-time streaming (Python Kafka Producer → Kafka on Docker → Structured Streaming) to simulate concurrent hospital feeds across 50 partitioned data folders.

projects.title: Local RAG Pipeline: Healthcare Patient Data Q&A with LangChain and Ollama
highlights: Built an end-to-end RAG pipeline using LangChain and locally hosted Gemma 4 (12B) via Ollama, enabling fully offline, privacy-preserving Q&A over structured healthcare data without external API dependencies.

Engineered a structured-to-text transformation layer converting Parquet records (output of an ETL pipeline) into semantically rich text summaries, making structured patient data searchable via natural language.
Built a vector ingestion pipeline using nomic-embed-text embeddings and ChromaDB as the local vector store, supporting batch ingestion of multi-part Parquet datasets with persistent storage.

Implemented an interactive conversational interface that retrieves semantically relevant patient records from ChromaDB and passes them as grounded context to Gemma 4, reducing hallucinations and anchoring responses to real data.

projects.title: Enterprise RAG Agent: Agentic Document Q&A with LangChain and Databricks
highlights: Built an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline with LangChain and Azure OpenAI for grounded, context-aware Q&A over enterprise documents, reducing LLM hallucinations.
Added an agentic orchestration layer that autonomously routes between vector search and keyword fallback based on query complexity.

Engineered a PySpark vector-ingestion pipeline (chunk, embed, index into FAISS / Azure AI Search) with incremental Delta Lake updates, plus a monitoring module logging retrieval relevance and flagging low-confidence responses.

projects.title: Real-Time Market Event Simulator
highlights: Developed a real-time market event simulation system using Apache Kafka, processing high-frequency financial data streams with producer-consumer architecture to simulate realistic market conditions.

Engineered multi-threaded event generation pipeline in Python that produces configurable market events (trades, orders, price updates) with customizable frequencies and batch sizes for performance testing.
Implemented robust data streaming infrastructure with Kafka topic management, consumer group handling, and offset tracking to ensure reliable message delivery and fault tolerance.
Built monitoring and analytics capabilities including real-time event consumption tracking, latency measurement, and throughput analysis to evaluate system performance under various load conditions.

Designed flexible configuration system supporting multiple market scenarios (normal, volatile, crash conditions) with parameterized event generation for testing different market behaviors and stress scenarios.

projects.title: Databricks Spark Query Listener – Streaming Job Monitoring Framework
highlights: Developed a Spark Query Listener based framework to capture job metrics, performance stats, and error events across structured streaming and batch pipelines in Databricks.
Integrated Kafka to stream Spark listener events into a centralized monitoring layer, enabling real time analysis and alerting.
Implemented a PySpark streaming pipeline to persist monitoring data in Delta tables managed by Unity Catalog for time series performance tracking.
Deployed infrastructure using Terraform and automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions, ensuring consistent provisioning across environments.

projects.title: Retail Analytics Platform (AWS)
highlights: Designed and implemented an automated ETL pipeline using AWS S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift to process 50K+ retail events/hour.
Built data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python and PySpark, handling structured and semi-structured datasets at scale.
Optimized SQL queries and partition strategies, reducing dashboard refresh latency and improving query performance by 30%.
Developed interactive dashboards in Power BI to track inventory trends, improving demand forecasting accuracy by 25%.
